exercises.title: Containment: light products of Acme
exercises.problemHtml:
Return the name of every product whose props contain brand Acme AND the tag light, ordered by id. Use one containment test.

Sample table (lesson 13.1)

product (id identity PK, name, props jsonb) — 5 rows:
 1 Laptop Pro 14  {"brand":"Acme","price":1299,"tags":["laptop","pro"],"specs":{"ram":16,"cpu":"M3"}}
 2 Laptop Air 13  {"brand":"Acme","price":999,"tags":["laptop","light"],"specs":{"ram":8,"cpu":"M2"}}
 3 Phone X        {"brand":"Zeta","price":799,"tags":["phone"],"specs":{"ram":8,"storage":256}}
 4 Tablet Mini    {"brand":"Zeta","price":449,"tags":["tablet","light"],"specs":{"ram":4}}
 5 Keyboard K1    {"brand":"Acme","price":89,"tags":["accessory"]}   ← no specs

Requirements

  • props @> '{"brand": "Acme", "tags": ["light"]}'.
  • An array in the pattern means "contains these elements", in any order.

Trả về name của mọi sản phẩm có props chứa brand Acme VÀ thẻ light, sắp theo id. Dùng một phép thử "chứa".

Yêu cầu

  • Mảng trong mẫu nghĩa là "chứa các phần tử này", thứ tự tuỳ ý.

exercises.title: Existence: who has specs, who has storage?
exercises.problemHtml:
Return name, has_specs, has_storage, phone_or_tablet for every product: whether props has a specs key, whether specs has a storage key, and whether the tags array contains phone or tablet. Order by id.

Sample table (lesson 13.1)

product (id identity PK, name, props jsonb) — 5 rows:
 1 Laptop Pro 14  {"brand":"Acme","price":1299,"tags":["laptop","pro"],"specs":{"ram":16,"cpu":"M3"}}
 2 Laptop Air 13  {"brand":"Acme","price":999,"tags":["laptop","light"],"specs":{"ram":8,"cpu":"M2"}}
 3 Phone X        {"brand":"Zeta","price":799,"tags":["phone"],"specs":{"ram":8,"storage":256}}
 4 Tablet Mini    {"brand":"Zeta","price":449,"tags":["tablet","light"],"specs":{"ram":4}}
 5 Keyboard K1    {"brand":"Acme","price":89,"tags":["accessory"]}   ← no specs

Requirements

  • props ? 'specs', props->'specs' ? 'storage' (NULL when there are no specs — wrap in COALESCE(…, false)).
  • props->'tags' ?| array['phone', 'tablet'].

exercises.title: A compact GIN index for the filter panel (jsonb_path_ops)
exercises.problemHtml:
The category page filters products with containment only, e.g. attrs @> '{"brand": "Thiên Long"}'. Create the smaller GIN flavour that supports exactly that operator on product.attrs.

Sample database: CT Shop mini (the course's lab project, sliced)

customer       (id PK, email UNIQUE lower-case, full_name, phone NULL, city DEFAULT 'Hà Nội', created_at timestamptz)
category       (id PK, name UNIQUE, parent_id → category.id — NULL = root)       12 rows: 1–4 roots, 5–12 children
product        (id PK, sku UNIQUE, name, category_id → category, price numeric(12,2) > 0, stock int ≥ 0 DEFAULT 0,
                attrs jsonb DEFAULT '{}', is_active boolean DEFAULT true, created_at)          16 rows (ids 1…46, gaps)
orders         (id PK, customer_id → customer, status pending|paid|shipped|cancelled, created_at timestamptz, note)   14 rows
order_item     (order_id → orders ON DELETE CASCADE, product_id → product, qty > 0, unit_price) — PK (order_id, product_id)
payment        (id PK, order_id UNIQUE → orders, amount, method cod|card|momo|bank, paid_at)    one per paid/shipped order

CREATE FUNCTION plan_nodes(q text) RETURNS text LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $f$
DECLARE j json; out text := '';
BEGIN
  EXECUTE 'EXPLAIN (FORMAT JSON, COSTS OFF) ' || q INTO j;
  WITH RECURSIVE n(p) AS (SELECT j -> 0 -> 'Plan' UNION ALL SELECT x FROM n, json_array_elements(n.p -> 'Plans') x)
  SELECT string_agg((p ->> 'Node Type') || coalesce(' on ' || (p ->> 'Index Name'), ''), ' / ') INTO out FROM n;
  RETURN out;
END $f$;
CREATE FUNCTION plan_text(q text) RETURNS text LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $f$
DECLARE r record; out text := '';
BEGIN
  FOR r IN EXECUTE 'EXPLAIN (COSTS OFF) ' || q LOOP out := out || r."QUERY PLAN" || E'\n'; END LOOP;
  RETURN out;
END $f$;
CREATE FUNCTION plan_rows(q text) RETURNS bigint LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $f$
DECLARE j json;
BEGIN
  EXECUTE 'EXPLAIN (FORMAT JSON) ' || q INTO j;
  RETURN (j -> 0 -> 'Plan' ->> 'Plan Rows')::numeric::bigint;
END $f$;
CREATE FUNCTION plan_analyze(q text) RETURNS text LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $f$
DECLARE r record; out text := '';
BEGIN
  FOR r IN EXECUTE 'EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, COSTS OFF, TIMING OFF, SUMMARY OFF, BUFFERS OFF) ' || q LOOP out := out || r."QUERY PLAN" || E'\n'; END LOOP;
  RETURN out;
END $f$;

CREATE FUNCTION plan_nodes(q text) RETURNS text LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $f$
DECLARE j json; out text := '';
BEGIN
  EXECUTE 'EXPLAIN (FORMAT JSON, COSTS OFF) ' || q INTO j;
  WITH RECURSIVE n(p) AS (SELECT j -> 0 -> 'Plan' UNION ALL SELECT x FROM n, json_array_elements(n.p -> 'Plans') x)
  SELECT string_agg((p ->> 'Node Type') || coalesce(' on ' || (p ->> 'Index Name'), ''), ' / ') INTO out FROM n;
  RETURN out;
END $f$;
CREATE FUNCTION plan_text(q text) RETURNS text LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $f$
DECLARE r record; out text := '';
BEGIN
  FOR r IN EXECUTE 'EXPLAIN (COSTS OFF) ' || q LOOP out := out || r."QUERY PLAN" || E'\n'; END LOOP;
  RETURN out;
END $f$;
CREATE FUNCTION plan_rows(q text) RETURNS bigint LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $f$
DECLARE j json;
BEGIN
  EXECUTE 'EXPLAIN (FORMAT JSON) ' || q INTO j;
  RETURN (j -> 0 -> 'Plan' ->> 'Plan Rows')::numeric::bigint;
END $f$;
CREATE FUNCTION plan_analyze(q text) RETURNS text LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $f$
DECLARE r record; out text := '';
BEGIN
  FOR r IN EXECUTE 'EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, COSTS OFF, TIMING OFF, SUMMARY OFF, BUFFERS OFF) ' || q LOOP out := out || r."QUERY PLAN" || E'\n'; END LOOP;
  RETURN out;
END $f$;

exercises.solutionExplanationHtml: jsonb_path_ops stores one hash per path-to-value, so the index is typically 2–3× smaller and lookups touch fewer entries. Choose it when your queries only use containment / jsonpath; keep jsonb_ops when you also test key existence.
exercises.solutionExplanationHtmlVi: jsonb_path_ops lưu một mã băm cho mỗi đường dẫn-tới-giá-trị, nên chỉ mục thường nhỏ hơn 2–3 lần và tra cứu chạm ít mục hơn. Chọn nó khi truy vấn chỉ dùng phép chứa / jsonpath; giữ jsonb_ops khi còn thử tồn tại khoá.

SET TimeZone = 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh';
CREATE TABLE customer (
  id          bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  email       text        NOT NULL,
  full_name   text        NOT NULL,
  phone       text,
  city        text        NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Hà Nội',
  created_at  timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  CONSTRAINT customer_email_key   UNIQUE (email),
  CONSTRAINT customer_email_check CHECK (email = lower(email) AND email LIKE '%_@_%.__%')
);
CREATE TABLE category (
  id         int  GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  name       text NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  parent_id  int  REFERENCES category(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
);
CREATE TABLE product (
  id           bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  sku          text          NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  name         text          NOT NULL,
  category_id  int           NOT NULL REFERENCES category(id),
  price        numeric(12,2) NOT NULL CHECK (price > 0),
  stock        int           NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (stock >= 0),
  attrs        jsonb         NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
  is_active    boolean       NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
  created_at   timestamptz   NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE TABLE orders (
  id           bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  customer_id  bigint      NOT NULL REFERENCES customer(id),
  status       text        NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending'
               CHECK (status IN ('pending', 'paid', 'shipped', 'cancelled')),
  created_at   timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  note         text
);
CREATE TABLE order_item (
  order_id    bigint        NOT NULL REFERENCES orders(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  product_id  bigint        NOT NULL REFERENCES product(id),
  qty         int           NOT NULL CHECK (qty > 0),
  unit_price  numeric(12,2) NOT NULL CHECK (unit_price > 0),
  PRIMARY KEY (order_id, product_id)
);
CREATE TABLE payment (
  id        bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  order_id  bigint        NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES orders(id),
  amount    numeric(12,2) NOT NULL CHECK (amount > 0),
  method    text          NOT NULL CHECK (method IN ('cod', 'card', 'momo', 'bank')),
  paid_at   timestamptz   NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE TABLE stock_movement (
  id          bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  product_id  bigint      NOT NULL REFERENCES product(id),
  change      int         NOT NULL CHECK (change <> 0),
  reason      text        NOT NULL CHECK (reason IN ('import', 'sale', 'return', 'adjust')),
  order_id    bigint      REFERENCES orders(id),
  created_at  timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE TABLE review (
  id           bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  product_id   bigint      NOT NULL REFERENCES product(id),
  customer_id  bigint      NOT NULL REFERENCES customer(id),
  rating       smallint    NOT NULL CHECK (rating BETWEEN 1 AND 5),
  body         text,
  created_at   timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  UNIQUE (product_id, customer_id)
);

CREATE FUNCTION plan_nodes(q text) RETURNS text LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $f$
DECLARE j json; out text := '';
BEGIN
  EXECUTE 'EXPLAIN (FORMAT JSON, COSTS OFF) ' || q INTO j;
  WITH RECURSIVE n(p) AS (SELECT j -> 0 -> 'Plan' UNION ALL SELECT x FROM n, json_array_elements(n.p -> 'Plans') x)
  SELECT string_agg((p ->> 'Node Type') || coalesce(' on ' || (p ->> 'Index Name'), ''), ' / ') INTO out FROM n;
  RETURN out;
END $f$;
CREATE FUNCTION plan_text(q text) RETURNS text LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $f$
DECLARE r record; out text := '';
BEGIN
  FOR r IN EXECUTE 'EXPLAIN (COSTS OFF) ' || q LOOP out := out || r."QUERY PLAN" || E'\n'; END LOOP;
  RETURN out;
END $f$;
CREATE FUNCTION plan_rows(q text) RETURNS bigint LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $f$
DECLARE j json;
BEGIN
  EXECUTE 'EXPLAIN (FORMAT JSON) ' || q INTO j;
  RETURN (j -> 0 -> 'Plan' ->> 'Plan Rows')::numeric::bigint;
END $f$;
CREATE FUNCTION plan_analyze(q text) RETURNS text LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $f$
DECLARE r record; out text := '';
BEGIN
  FOR r IN EXECUTE 'EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, COSTS OFF, TIMING OFF, SUMMARY OFF, BUFFERS OFF) ' || q LOOP out := out || r."QUERY PLAN" || E'\n'; END LOOP;
  RETURN out;
END $f$;
